description: ToDesk remote desktop client for Windows
##: Windows 64-bit payload only; the NSIS installer carries both app64.7z and app32.7z.
post_install expands app64.7z and removes the NSIS leftovers and the unused 32-bit payload.
checkver reads win_link from the Nuxt state on the download page to skip the gray release.
autoupdate.hash is omitted: the vendor publishes no checksum, so Excavator downloads the 150 MB installer.
notes: Unpacked layout: the vendor setup normally registers services and virtual drivers, so some features may require elevation on first launch.
